guarantees_lost_or_changed: The unqualified current privileged/all-writer protection claim would become conditional on an explicitly bounded trusted infrastructure.
No promised prevention of deliberate trusted-administrator, kernel/hypervisor or raw device/physical tampering; observation of every such breach is also not guaranteed.
Missing trusted-infrastructure conformance can invalidate the proposed protection claim even if workload checks pass.

Time-integrity protection would become conditional on explicitly trusted local host/time infrastructure rather than treating every privileged or hidden clock-domain manipulation as an independently enforceable threat.
No guarantee of detecting deliberate hidden kernel/hypervisor clock manipulation or snapshot rollback by assumed-trusted actors, even when a boot identifier appears unchanged.

A local read or delivered timer alone supplies neither an absolute response/drain bound nor authenticated issuer/time mapping or durable rights. The proposal changes the clock trust claim, not the original finite deadline or recovery budget.

joint_proposed_statements.actor_and_action_scope: DRAFT: Only specifically enumerated infrastructure actors in their precisely identified infrastructure action roles may be part of the proposed conformance assumption. joint_proposed_statements.failure_and_acceptance: DRAFT: Known infrastructure trust/control failure preserves original failure and separately known mismatches;unknown membership/object/source/guard/drain/storage/time state remains pending and denies dependent effects. No actual composition, component, test grant, deadline/budget renewal or operational policy is issued.
joint_proposed_statements.guard_lifetime: DRAFT joint retention requirement: establish service/ledger controls before their own first effects;worker traps before worker effects;stable distinct target guard and fresh original in-memory capture before transaction-owned writes;known exact backups before target mutation. Keep each relevant exclusion continuously through owned/target/config/package/source/recovery/target evidence and all descendants/FD/stream/in-flight effects until independently known scoped closure. Guard owner loss/replacement/contention/unknown never authorizes force unlock, unlink/recreate, reacquire, rebind, renewed rights or presumed child drain. Separate publication/custody controls persist through the proposed terminal boundary;target closure does not close them.
joint_proposed_statements.source_consumption: DRAFT joint retention requirement: bind and continuously protect all actual launcher/interpreter/loader/library/config/helper/archive/backend/selector/hook/observer/collector/injector/consumer code and input objects from check through every real consumption, including parent/mount/backing/FD aliases. Deliberate out-of-policy tampering by those enumerated infrastructure roles is outside the proposed guarantee and is not promised detectable. Ordinary faults, partial writes, lost ACK, provider/control loss, suspend/restart/delay and observed/suspected discontinuities remain reviewed failures; they are not permitted workload behavior or successful control.
